criteria.criterion: Shipped 001/002 remain analyzer exit 0. New-contract integrity failures stay errors, while missing legacy FM/provenance/config is reported without retroactively claiming freshness. Documentation and fixtures explicitly distinguish analyzer compatibility from a floor that cannot clear without runnable verification. (CON-003, REQ-007, REQ-009) ## 7. Constraints - **CON-001:** Bash 3.2, BSD/POSIX tools and the existing CI matrix; no new runtime dependency. The plan pre-decides parsable metadata/report/command grammars and their failure behavior before script implementation. - **CON-002:** Kit source files stay byte-identical with the private clone after the existing post-merge port. This change ships here first. - **CON-003:** Shipped specs 001/002 retain analyzer exit 0. Missing legacy metadata yields warnings and freshness-unknown, never an invented PASS. New-contract specs require full bindings/configuration at the appropriate handoff; malformed declared data and dangling/duplicate IDs are errors. Tests-with-tasks remains a warning, with zero allowed at new task handoff. - **CON-004:** Models.yml roles/tiers, gate separation/defaults and security reviewer authority do not change. A round waiver permits an invocation, not a softened verdict or skipped criterion. - **CON-005:** Persona edits regenerate through apply-models.sh and build-adapters.sh; sync --check and doctor remain clean within their existing environment requirements. Never edit generated build/ by hand. - **CON-006:** This repo has stacks: [] but an executable shell suite. Text checks validate stack advice; runtime fixtures validate the common harness. Cross-stack live effects are measured in later governed specs. - **CON-007:** Worktree guards, clarification markers and evidence-not-claims remain enforced. Reuse means consuming a verified matching real run, never trusting an implementer's prose or only a filename/hash claim. - **CON-008:** Implement FM/test binding, class sweeps, output bounds and the shared floor before enabling reuse/carry-forward. Reuse remains disabled until provenance and invalidation fixtures pass. Acceptance and shared evidence mutations are serialized; source snapshots must remain stable through capture/validation, including parallel worker batches. ## 8. Open questions None blocking. Existing user choices are preserved; the review corrections are recorded in STATUS. Which governed project supplies the first later measurement point remains a non-blocking owner choice. Missing baseline or follow-up measurements are reported as unknown. ## 9.
